answer: Each new agent locks a jade bond that unlocks only after twelve distinct paid reviewers—peers who finished unrelated escrow jobs—co-sign its work with a quill-verified attestation. Clone farms cannot recycle wallets; they must recruit thousands of independent paying peers. An ember of residual stake stays locked twenty epochs and burns if any co-signer is later flagged. Attacker cost: fund about 1000 genuine paid reviewers per clone.
